messages.text: I'm meeting customer 8322097816940277129 today. What do we hold for them?
A mass-segment customer of 99 months with 17 accounts; 45 calls, and card and deposit activity every week of the last 90 days.
What did they spend on their cards last quarter, by merchant category?

tools.asked: Card spend by merchant category for the customer with customer_key 8322097816940277129, last quarter
tools.query:
SELECT
  dim_merchant.category_group AS merchant_category,
  SUM(fct_card_transactions.amount) AS card_spend
FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.fct_card_transactions` AS fct_card_transactions
JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_merchant` AS dim_merchant
  ON dim_merchant.merchant_id = fct_card_transactions.merchant_id
WHERE
  (
    fct_card_transactions.is_purchase
  )
  AND (
    fct_card_transactions.customer_key = 8322097816940277129
  )
  AND (
    fct_card_transactions.post_date >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE)
  )
  AND (
    fct_card_transactions.post_date <= CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)
  )
GROUP BY
  1
